parsed.post: Discarding the 0.9946 run (leakage confirmed). Reverting to the best known config but switching TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' to establish a clean baseline. My next run will be the clean re-baseline: DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.03, BATCH=262144, SHARDS='0-9'.
parsed.description: Re-baselining the previous best configuration on the clean '0-9' shard set to quantify the actual non-leaked performance.
